| **P7** | `C2`: the **positive control** — injecting the *exact* `E21` **and** `E3` at every layer — reproduces the uncapped flow to `<= 1e-12` relative final-layer MSE. If it does not, the flow's state carries more than its two read-slices, the premise of `C2`/`C3` is wrong, and **this contract's `C2` and `C3` are VOID pending re-derivation** | this is the null-control debt discharged with a control that differs in **code path**, and it is a genuine falsifier of the whole lane |
| **P8** | `C2`: the projected injection is **NOT destructive** — drift falls monotonically in `r` at every `r` on the grid, unlike WP10's variance channel | mechanism: this corrects the *same* object the closure truncates, in the direction of the exact flow, whereas WP10 made one marginal exact while its partner stayed truncated |
| **P9** | `C2`: end-to-end drift at `r = 512` falls **`3.0x`–`4.5x`**, point **`3.6x`**, from the paired uncorrected drift — i.e. **`G-E2E` FAILS its `>= 5x` clause and clears its `< 2x` falsifier**. On the `eps^2` exponent a `5x` fall needs `>= 0.80` *total*-energy containment, and my P3 layer-1 point of `0.66` on `r90`-energy does not support it | I expect the most useful outcome available: a real, large, insufficient gain — which points at `C3`'s cheap `E3` leg rather than at a bigger `r` |
| **P10** | `C2`: the **free `E3` arm** — carrying the discarded `(3,)`-slice residual exactly, an `n`-vector at `O(n)` per layer — buys **`>= 1.3x`** drift reduction on its own, at a counted cost below `1e8` FLOPs total (`< 0.00005 B`) | `rel_E3` is `0.28`–`0.33`, a third of the discarded energy, and it is a vector. If this holds it is the cheapest accuracy in the project's history |
| **P11** | `C4`: the low-rank backbone at `r = 128`, `l0 = 7`, Strassen `L = 1`, **including the range-finder's own cost**, saves **`[0.020, 0.038] B`** (point `0.029 B` = `63,780,000,000` FLOPs) against the dense backbone — **less than the naive `8x` contraction saving**, because the range finder is itself `~3` matmul-equivalents of `n^2 r` per layer | the strategist's `~8x` prices the contraction and not the basis; the honest figure includes it |
| **P12** | `C4`: `G-FLOOR` **PASSES** — total `<= 219,885,548,339` counted FLOPs (so `total + 2^24 <= 0.10 B`) at Strassen `L <= 1` with drift `<= 1.5x` dense — **only if P1 holds**. Conditional on P1 failing, `G-FLOOR` fails and the floor needs Strassen `L = 2`, which needs a brokered soak | the two cells are coupled and I am saying so before either runs |

**Three of these twelve predict failure of a gate in this contract (P6, P9, and
P12 conditionally), and P7 is written so that it can void two of my own cells.**

## Gates — every threshold in the unit it will be scored in, in the same sentence

| gate | cell | threshold, in its scoring unit |
|---|---|---|
| **G-CONTAIN** | `C1` | The mean-over-8-networks containment fraction of `E21`'s `r90`-energy in `span(Q_l)` at **`r = 512`** is **`>= 0.60` at layers 1–4**, **`>= 0.80` at layers `>= 10`**, **and `>= 1.5x` the random-orthonormal null at every layer** (the null's expectation is `r/n = 0.500` at `r = 512`, so this third clause means **`>= 0.75`** and is the binding one). Scored **per layer**, on the paired difference `d_i = c_i - max(threshold, 1.5 * null_i)` with a studentised-`t` lower bound `> 0`; the per-network minimum is reported beside it. |
| **G-E2E** | `C2` | Paired per-network final-layer drift against the uncapped full-K3 flow, `r = 512`, injected in flight: **`drift_corrected <= drift_uncorrected / 5`**, i.e. the studentised-`t` lower bound of `mean_i(drift_unc_i - 5 * drift_corr_i)` is `> 0`. Against WP13's committed anchor that is **`<= 1.70e-07`** absolute. |
| **G-POS** | `C2` | Positive control: exact `E21` + `E3` injection reproduces the uncapped flow to **relative final-layer MSE `<= 1e-12`**. **A FAILURE VOIDS `C2` AND `C3`.** |
| **G-DEPLOY** | `C3` | Retains **`>= 60%`** of `C2`'s measured drift reduction — studentised-`t` lower bound `> 0` on `d_i = (drift_unc_i - drift_C3_i) - 0.6 * (drift_unc_i - drift_C2_i)` — **and** total counted flopscope FLOPs **`<= 263,882,790,666`** (`= 0.12 B`) at Strassen `L <= 2`. |
| **G-FLOOR** | `C4` | Total counted flopscope FLOPs **`<= 219,885,548,339`**, so that `total + 2^24 <= 219,902,325,555` (`= 0.10 B`), at Strassen `L <= 1`, **and** final-layer MSE against `C0-i`'s minted truth **`<= 1.5x`** the dense-backbone arm's MSE on the same eight networks (paired, studentised-`t` lower bound of `mean_i(1.5 * mse_dense_i - mse_lowrank_i) > 0`). |

**No gate in this contract is scored on an upstream torch-side counter, on a
composed excess through the `eps^2` amplitude, or on a local wall time.** The
`eps^2` law appears in P9 as a *prediction*, never as a gate.

## Falsifiers

- `C1`: containment at or below the random-orthonormal null at any `r` → **the free
  selector is dead**, `C2`/`C3` are not run, and only `C4` proceeds.
- `C2`: drift falls **`< 2x`**, or rises at any `r` → freeze at the uncorrected
  regenerating flow and stop spending on accuracy.
- `C2` `G-POS` fails → `C2` and `C3` are VOID; the premise that the flow reads
  `kappa_3` through exactly two slices is wrong and must be re-derived.
- `C4`: the amplified accuracy cost exceeds the multiplier gain (the paired
  `mse * multiplier` score is not improved) → settle at Strassen `L = 1`–`2` and
  stop.
- `C0-iii`: the f32 spelling does not bill at half → P1 refuted, every cost
  statement in this contract reverts to the f64 table, and `G-FLOOR` almost
  certainly fails.

## Baseline, and the null controls — each differs in CODE PATH, not in a parameter

`SKEPTIC WP13`'s binding process rule, and this repository's fifth consecutive
attempt to satisfy it.

| control | what it is | why it is code-path-distinct |
|---|---|---|
| **N-RAND** (`C1`) | containment against `Q = orth(G)`, `G ~ N(0,1)` `n x r` | the basis never touches `Sigma`; a different matrix is factorised, not the same call with a changed argument |
| **N-XLAYER** (`C1`) | containment against `Q` built from a **different network's** `Sigma` at the same layer, identical range-finder code | same code, genuinely different data — separates "`Sigma`'s range" from "any basis this code produces" |
| **S-POS** (`C2`) | exact `E21` + `E3` injection (`G-POS`) | a positive control that must reproduce a *different* flow (the uncapped one) through a different execution path |
| **N-ZERO** (`C2`) | `r = 0` — the projector is empty, so the corrected flow must be bit-identical to the uncapped regenerating arm and to `p2_pb_rank.predict(cap="dsproj")` | this one IS the same call with a changed parameter, and is recorded as a **determinism check, not a null control**, per WP13's finding (4) |
| **S2-1024** (`C2`) | `p2_slice_lab.py`'s load-bearing null, re-established at **`1024 x 16`** for the new insertion point | WP13 left it run only at `256 x 4`; this discharges the narrowed debt at the shape every number is quoted at |
| **DTYPE-F64** (`C1`) | the whole `C1` containment sweep re-run in **float64** on 2 networks x layers `{1, 7, 14}` | the f64 control that does not exist anywhere in the repository — `p2_slice_lab.py` has no f64 path at all |

Baselines: `C1` — the two nulls above. `C2`/`C3` — the paired uncorrected
regenerating arm on the same eight networks (DESIGN tier). `C4` — the dense
`w.T @ cov @ w` backbone on the same eight networks, and `C0-i`'s minted truth.

## Cost model — REQUIRED, and round-dependent

**Phase 2 sets `lambda = 0`, so `C = F` and residual is not a cost.** Every cost
figure in this contract is **counted flopscope 0.12 FLOPs**, executed and metered,
never modelled, never an upstream torch-side counter, and always with its **dtype
named** — which is the whole point of `C0-iii`. The budget is
`2^41 = 2,199,023,255,552`; `0.10 B = 219,902,325,555`; the K2 backbone anchor is
the shipped file's official one-row subprocess figure `137,600,326,656`. The
grading server's unexplained `+2^24` is added to any total within `0.5%` of the
floor.

Residual is reported as **headroom against the `0.4 s` per-MLP cliff**,
`0.4 / observed`, quoted against the **worst** observed row of a brokered `gpuq`
soak, per `VALIDATION.md` §2b-ii. §2b's three-residual-model rule is Phase-1 replay
and does not apply here. **No local absolute wall time is quoted as authority.**
Strassen levels are counted as **array operations** as well as FLOPs, because
`L = 4`'s `~1.1 M` ops/MLP is the thing that fails the cliff.

## Statistic

Paired, common random numbers, **arithmetic differences**, studentised-`t` or
basic-bootstrap intervals via `competition_score.paired_diff_ci(d, method="t")` and
`method="basic"`. **Percentile and BCa are refused** (measured false-promotion
rates `6.8–8.2%` and `9.1–11.5%` against a nominal `5%`). Every ratio gate above is
written as a **linear contrast**, so no bare ratio of means is ever quoted. `n = 8`
networks throughout, which is the floor `SKEPTIC WP13` set and not a population;
every interval is reported with its width, and no result is promoted on `n = 8`
alone.

## Seed block

**No new seeds.** `C0-i`, `C1`, `C2`, `C3` and `C4` all run on
`P01[40,821,001,168 .. 40,821,001,175]` — the eight DESIGN networks WP13 already
claimed. `C0-i` records a **deliberate DESIGN-tier overlap** through
`seed_ledger.claim_range(..., artifact=...)` with the artifact named **at claim
time**, so `finalize()` can close it; the ledger prints the overlap and it is
recorded here. Because these are the same networks WP13 measured `E2` on,
**`C1`'s containment result and WP13's spectra are CORRELATED evidence and must
never be quoted as independent.** `P04` is not touched. The vault is not touched.

## Confounders, scope, and what must not change

- **`f32` risk.** Every WP13 spectrum and every number here is `float32` unless the
  `DTYPE-F64` control says otherwise. That control covers `C1` only; `C2`'s
  end-to-end arm remains `f32`, and that is stated as a limitation, not waved away.
- **The range finder is not free unless `C4` is adopted.** Building `Q_l` costs
  `~8`–`12 n^2 r` per layer, which at `r = 512` is `~0.044 B` — comparable to the
  correction it enables. `C1`/`C2` are therefore **oracle-side** experiments about
  *information*, and `C3` is the only cell that may claim deployability. If `C4` is
  adopted the basis is already paid for and the selector really is free; that
  coupling is asserted here **before** either result exists so that it cannot be
  claimed afterwards.
- **`C2` uses the corrected flow's own `Sigma`**, not the reference flow's, so the
  selector is one a deployed estimator could actually build.
- **`E21` is defined post-`contract_W`**, in the next layer's index space. The
  injection hook therefore runs **after the linear step**, not after the
  nonlinearity where `p2_slice_lab.py`'s hook runs. This is a different insertion
  point, and `S2-1024` must be re-established for it.
- **The true residual comes from a reference uncapped flow run in lockstep**, not
  from the corrected flow's own next layer. Both flows are driven on identical
  inputs and identical weights.
- **`n = 8`.** Enough for a monotone trend and a paired interval; not a population.
- **Must not change:** `estimator.py`, the vault, `competition_score.py`,
  `seed_blocks.py`, `seed_ledger.py`, `p2_pb_rank.py`, `p2_slice_lab.py`'s measured
  cells, and every closed lane (AUGMENT, the carrier, the learned output corrector,
  W-EFF, late-window K3, global scale mixtures, Route A, Route B's selector).
  Nothing here reopens one.
- **No submission is authorised by this contract.** The next canary is the `fnp`
  port at Strassen `L = 1` after `certify_candidate` and a brokered residual soak,
  presented to Samuel with its `submission.tar.gz` and SHA. `whest submit` is never
  run by an agent, and no nomination is designated by one.

## Kill lines

`C0`/`C1`/`C2` answered by **2026-09-06**. `C3`/`C4`, the certified `fnp` port and
the first canary by **2026-09-13**. If by **2026-09-16** neither `C2` (the subspace
is sufficient) nor `C4` (the floor is reachable) has passed, accuracy and cost work
**freeze**: nominate the uncorrected regenerating flow at `L = 1` — if and only if
`C0-i`'s minted truth confirms it beats v2.7 — plus v2.7 as the diverse pair, and
go all-in on `docs/writeup-p2-draft.md` (due 2026-10-24).

# 2026-09-02 — WP14 / C0-iii RESULT: the cost half of this project was priced in the wrong dtype, and at the right one the multiplier is AT THE FLOOR

Contract `d915f83`, committed before this ran. Instrument
`local_sim/p2_slice_cost.py --dtype {f64,f32,both}`; artifacts
`experiments/2026-09-02_wp14_range/e0_cost_f64.json` and `e0_cost_f32.json`.
No seeds, no GPU, no networks: the counted total is value-invariant and
`--dtype f64` reproduces WP13's committed figure exactly.

## What was wrong

flopscope 0.12 does not price a matmul at `4 n^3`. It prices it at the textbook
`2 n^3` and then scales every operation by a **per-dtype billing rate** from its
own packaged weights (`flopscope/_weights.py::_ACTIVE_DTYPE_RATES`):

    float64 = 2.0   float32 = 1.0   float16 = 1.0   int64 = 2.0   complex128 = 2.0

`p2_slice_cost.py` built every array from `np.random.default_rng().standard_normal()`,
which returns **float64**. So WP13's entire cost table — `0.15272 B`, "the floor
affords `3.2` matmuls per layer", "Strassen `L = 4` is needed to reach `0.1`" — is
a **float64** statement, and it was compared against accuracy evidence that
`p2_slice_lab.py` gathered in **torch float32**. This is the `G-RANK` failure class
from `SKEPTIC WP13` again — a threshold quoted in a currency the measurement was
not taken in — caught this time before the gate was written rather than after.

## P1 HELD, to the FLOP

| arm | third-order increment | matmul price | total with the K2 anchor | `x budget` |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `--dtype f64` (WP13's arm, reproduced) | `198,233,321,472` | `4.00 n^3` | `335,833,648,128` | `0.152719` |
| `--dtype f32` | **`99,116,660,736`** | `2.00 n^3` | `236,716,987,392` | **`0.107646`** |

Predicted `99,116,660,736 +/- 2%` and `0.10765 B`. Measured `99,116,660,736` and
`0.107646 B` — exactly half, exactly as the rate table says. Per-layer cost is
`5.77 n^3` at f32 against `11.54 n^3` at f64; **`2.89` matmuls per layer in both**,
which is the invariant that proves only the currency changed and not the spelling.

The f64 arm reproducing `198,233,321,472` **after** the edit is the regression that
matters: `np.float64(3.0)` was replaced by a Python `3.0` throughout, because under
NEP-50 a numpy scalar is *concrete* and would have promoted the f32 arm straight
back to f64 billing. `measure()` now asserts the carried state's dtype and refuses
rather than reporting a silently-promoted number.

## And composing it with a figure this repository already had changes the answer

The K2 backbone half was measured and independently reviewed on **2026-08-26**, and
sat in `docs/CURRENT_STATE.md` unconnected to any K3 number:

> **In grader spelling the ratio is `0.50002x`** (`137,600,363,520 -> 68,802,510,336`),
> stable across five shapes and bit-identical across nine networks. Divergence from
> the f64 control is `3.3e-13` relative mean square — **7.1 orders** below K2's own
> error. `1,497` of `1,572,864` neuron-layers hit float32 cancellation in
> `var = max(ez2 - mu^2, 0)`; the `var_pre` clamp fires **zero** times, there are
> zero non-finite outputs on 96/96 networks, and the float32 final-layer MSE against
> truth is *marginally better* than float64.

Composing the two **measured** halves:

| composition | K2 backbone | K3 increment | total | `x budget` | multiplier |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| all f64 — WP13's record | `137,600,326,656` | `198,233,321,472` | `335,833,648,128` | `0.15272` | `0.15272` |
| K3 f32 only | `137,600,326,656` | `99,116,660,736` | `236,716,987,392` | `0.10765` | `0.10765` |
| **both f32** | `68,802,510,336` | `99,116,660,736` | **`167,919,171,072`** | **`0.07636`** | **`0.10000`** |

> **A regenerating full-K3 flow reaches the `0.1` multiplier floor with `0.02364 B`
> to spare, with NO Strassen, NO low-rank backbone and NO rank cap.** That spare is
> `51,983,154,483` counted FLOPs — `24.2` dense f32 matmuls, `1.61` per layer — and
> a rank-`512` slice correction at f32 costs `16,106,127,360`, so it fits **`3.2`
> times over**.

**This is a PROJECTION and is labelled one.** The two halves are measured in
different spellings — the K2 figure is a grader-spelling arm, the K3 figure is a
hand spelling metered locally — and their sum has never been executed as one
program. It implies nothing about `whest validate`, the `4 GiB` single-array rule,
the `8 GiB` memory cap or the `0.4 s` residual cliff. The `fnp` port exists to turn
it into a measurement.

## What this does to WP14 and to the standing plan

**P12's conditional resolves in the favourable direction, and `C4` changes job.**
The contract said: *"if P1 holds, `C4` becomes a margin lever rather than the only
route."* P1 held. `G-FLOOR`'s `<= 219,885,548,339` clause is met by
`167,919,171,072` before `C4` runs at all, so `C4` is no longer the route to the
floor — it is now a way of **buying accuracy headroom**, and it is de-prioritised
behind `C1`/`C2`/`C3` accordingly. Its gate stands as written and will be scored if
it runs; nothing is retro-fitted.

**Cost is no longer the binding constraint. Accuracy is, and it is the only thing
left.** At the floor the score is `raw / 10`:

| arm | raw final-layer MSE | adjusted at `0.1` |
|---|---:|---:|
| full factorized K3 (measured, 24 DESIGN mints) | `4.0047e-08` | **`4.005e-09`** |
| regenerating flow, uncorrected (P2's point, UNMEASURED) | `~8.9e-07` | `~8.9e-08` |
| board leader Puffi | — | `4.5e-09` |
| graded v2.7 | `1.374e-06` | `1.374e-07` |

The leader needs raw `4.5e-08`; full K3 is `4.0e-08`. **So the whole competition,
for us, has collapsed onto one number: how much of the `22x` gap between the
regenerating flow and full K3 can `C1`/`C2`/`C3` close inside `0.0236 B`.** That is
exactly what the rest of this contract measures, and it is now the only thing worth
measuring.

## Knowledge delta

1. **A dtype is part of a price, not a detail of it.** flopscope's cost is
   dtype-weighted by an official table, so "this costs `X` FLOPs" is not a
   well-formed sentence without the dtype. WP13's `4 n^3` was never a fact about
   matmul. `docs/GOTCHAS.md` is corrected.
2. **Two measured halves nobody had added.** Both numbers in the winning
   composition were already in this repository, both independently reviewed, and
   the gap between them was six days and one page of `CURRENT_STATE.md`. The cost
   lane was not short of measurement; it was short of one addition.
3. **`SKEPTIC WP13`'s rule paid immediately.** *"Write every threshold in the unit
   the gate will be scored in, and say so in the same sentence"* is what forced
   `C0-iii` into the contract at all, four days after the rule was written.

# 2026-09-02 — WP14 instrument note: a self-test changed C2's mechanism BEFORE any C2 data existed

Contract `d915f83`. Instrument `local_sim/p2_range_lab.py`; self-test artifact
`experiments/2026-09-02_wp14_range/selftest_cpu128.json`. Recorded here, and
committed before the `gpuq` job was submitted, so the change is provably not a
response to a result.

## What the self-test found

`C2` was first written to inject its correction by rebuilding the tower from its
own repeated slices — `K[3] = from_dstensor(K[3].get_repeated())` with the slices
modified — at the linear step. **S-IDEM** asks the prior question: is that rebuild
a no-op when nothing is modified? At `128 x 4`, in the UNCAPPED flow, it is not:

    relative divergence of the final-layer means:  3.056e-03

The mechanism is `factor_k3.py:381`. `factored_nonlin_kprop_k3` starts with
`pK_111 = WK[3].clone()` and carries the **incoming** `kappa_3`'s entire factored
tensor forward as the outgoing one, all-distinct block included. It only ever
*reads* the two repeated slices, but it *propagates* everything. So a rebuild at
the linear point does not preserve the flow: it kills a block that would otherwise
have reached the **next** layer's slices, applying a second truncation on top of
the one under test. Every `C2` cell would have been measuring the sum of two
approximations while reporting one.

## What it did NOT refute, and this distinction is the whole point

It refutes *"a rebuild is a no-op"*. It does **not** refute *"the final means read
`kappa_3` only through its two slices"* — which is the premise `C2`, `C3` and
`G-POS` actually rest on. That premise is now demonstrated end to end rather than
argued: with the corrected mechanism, the `exact` cell — both slices forced to the
reference flow's values at every layer — reproduces the uncapped flow's final means
to **`1.5e-15`** absolute drift against an uncorrected `5.4e-06`, a factor of
`3.7e+09`, on both smoke networks. **`G-POS` stands exactly as pre-registered** and
is not amended; `1024 x 16` is where it will be scored.

## The corrected mechanism

The correction is **added, never rebuilt**. For a diagonal-free `(2,1)` correction
`Delta` and a `(3,)` correction `delta`,

    K[3] <- K[3].add_factors( (diag(delta) + 3 Delta^T, I, I) )

which is the same `(M, I, I)` form `from_dstensor` itself produces. Working through
`_factored_get_dslice` for `d = 3`: the `(3,)` slice of `(M, I, I)` is `diag(M)`,
and its `(2,1)` slice is `M^T / 3` with the diagonal zeroed. So the block adds
exactly `delta` to one slice and exactly `Delta` to the other and nothing else to
either. **S-SLICE executes that claim in flight** rather than leaving it in this
paragraph: measured `0.0` and `5.0e-08` relative on the two slices.

Two details that would each have been a silent defect:

- **`Delta`'s diagonal must be zeroed explicitly.** `E21` is diagonal-free, but
  `Q Q^T E21` is not, and `(M, I, I)` routes `diag(M)` into the `(3,)` slice — so
  an unzeroed projection would have leaked `3 * Delta_ii` into a slice the cell was
  not correcting.
- **The added block creates an all-distinct block of its own**, which then
  propagates. That is a property of the deployable operation, not an error, and
  `C2` measures what it costs rather than assuming it away.

## Self-tests now standing, at `128 x 4` on CPU

| check | result |
|---|---|
| **S1** hookless two-hook re-drive `==` `p2_pb_rank(cap="none")` | **BIT-IDENTICAL** |
| **S2** regeneration hook `==` `p2_pb_rank(cap="dsproj")` | **BIT-IDENTICAL** |
| **S-IDEM** rebuild at the linear point (diagnostic, not a gate) | `3.056e-03` — expected, mechanism above |
| **S-SLICE** `add_factors` moves `(3,)` by exactly `delta` | `0.0` |
| **S-SLICE** `add_factors` moves `(2,1)` by exactly `Delta` | `5.028e-08` |
| **S-ADDZERO** a zero factor block is a numerical no-op | `9.837e-08` — a **determinism check, not a null control** |
| **S-RF** `Q^T Q - I` max abs error, `r = 32 / 64` | `2.7e-07` / `3.6e-07` |
| **S-CONT** containment inside `span(Q)` / in its complement | `1.000000014` / `3.6e-14` |

**S2 still runs at a small shape here.** The contract's `S2-1024` — the load-bearing
null at the shape every reported number is taken at, which `SKEPTIC WP13` recorded
as an outstanding debt — runs inside the submitted job, not on this host.

## And a warning the smoke is entitled to give

At `128 x 4`, containment of `E21` by `Sigma`'s range is `0.24`–`0.28` at `r = 32`
against a random-orthonormal null of `0.25`: **indistinguishable from noise**, and
`proj:32` buys `1.03x`–`1.09x` against `svd:32`'s `1.5x`–`2.0x`. That is exactly
the shape of a `C1` falsifier.

It is **not evidence**, and it is recorded as not evidence: `128 x 4` is a depth at
which none of the collapse this contract is built on has happened yet
(`r90(Sigma)` falls `237 -> 26` over *sixteen* layers, and there are four here).
The whole hypothesis is that containment improves with depth. A smoke at depth 4
tests the instrument and cannot test the claim — but it does mean **P6 and the `C1`
falsifier are live possibilities and not rhetorical ones**, and it is written down
before the real numbers arrive so that a failure cannot be reported as a surprise.

Free `E3` is the other thing the smoke hints at: `2.0x`–`2.3x` drift reduction from
correcting the `(3,)` slice alone, an `n`-vector at `O(n)` per layer. **P10
predicted `>= 1.3x`.** Also not evidence, also at the wrong shape.

# 2026-09-02 — WP14 RESULT: cost is solved and accuracy is not. The free selector does not exist, and `Sigma`'s range is EXACTLY a random subspace.

Contract `d915f83`, committed before any cell ran. Instruments
`local_sim/p2_slice_cost.py` (`--dtype`), `local_sim/p2_truth.py`
(`--seed-start`/`--already-claimed`), `local_sim/p2_range_lab.py`,
`local_sim/p2_truth_score.py`, `local_sim/p2_k3_fnp.py`. Artifacts in
`experiments/2026-09-02_wp14_range/` and `experiments/2026-09-02_wp14_fnp/`.
`gpuq` jobs 121, 122, 124, 131, 132. Seeds: the eight `P01` networks WP13 already
claimed, **no new draw**, deliberate DESIGN-tier overlap recorded in the ledger
with the artifact named at claim time.

**Two results, and they point in opposite directions.**

## 1. `C0-iii` — the multiplier floor is reached, and it was reached by a units fix

Full entry above (`3b38796`). In one table:

| composition | K2 backbone | K3 increment | total | `x budget` | multiplier |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| all f64 — WP13's record | `137,600,326,656` | `198,233,321,472` | `335,833,648,128` | `0.15272` | `0.15272` |
| **both f32** | `68,802,510,336` | `99,116,660,736` | **`167,919,171,072`** | **`0.07636`** | **`0.10000`** |

flopscope bills the textbook `2 n^3` for a matmul and scales by a per-dtype rate
(`float64 = 2.0`, `float32 = 1.0`). WP13's `4 n^3` was the f64 column read as a
property of matmul. **P1 HELD to the FLOP.** A regenerating K3 flow reaches the
`0.1` floor with `0.02364 B` — `51,983,154,483` FLOPs, `24.2` f32 matmuls — to
spare, with no Strassen and no rank cap. `docs/GOTCHAS.md` is corrected and
write-up §6 is rewritten.

## 2. `C0-i` — the fallback is real, measured, and modest. P2 HELD.

Truth minted on the eight WP13 networks (`gpuq` 121, `2^22` samples x 2
independent replicas, sha256 `a3c27a7d...`, ledger finalised on the host). Scored
with the **cross-product** estimator, whose expectation is `MSE(p)` exactly
because the replicas share no state.

| arm | raw final-layer MSE | adjusted at `0.1` | vs graded v2.7 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| uncapped full K3 | `3.7179e-08` | `3.718e-09` | `36.9x` |
| **regenerating flow, uncorrected** | **`8.5075e-07`** | **`8.508e-08`** | **`1.61x`** |
| our K2p1 closure, uncalibrated | `3.8137e-06` | `3.814e-07` | `0.36x` |
| drift, regen vs uncapped | `8.7545e-07` | — | — |

**P2 HELD**: pre-registered `[7.5e-07, 1.0e-06]`, point `8.9e-07` (the
*orthogonal-error* point `MSE_full + drift`); measured `8.5075e-07`. WP13's
`2.4x`-wide bracket `[5.2e-08, 1.26e-07]` collapses to a number, and it is
**`1.61x` better than graded v2.7** — real, and not close to the board.

*Noise discipline*: GT noise is `1.72e-08` per replica at `2^22`, `2%` of the
regenerating arm and **`43%` of full K3's own MSE**. The `uncapped` row is a
diagnostic, not a re-measurement of P-A's `4.0047e-08` (with which it is
consistent). Stated in the module before the run, not after.

## 3. `C1` — **G-CONTAIN FAILS**, and the manner of the failure is the finding

`E21`'s leading subspace is contained in `Sigma`'s dominant range **exactly as
much as it is contained in a random subspace of the same dimension**, at every
depth and every rank, on all 8 networks.

| layer | `r90(E21)` | `r=128` | `r=256` | `r=512` | `r=768` | ratio to the random null at `r=512` |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 263.6 | `0.1272` | `0.2517` | `0.5020` | `0.7511` | `1.003` |
| 4 | 189.4 | `0.1273` | `0.2518` | `0.5006` | `0.7511` | `1.001` |
| 7 | 144.4 | `0.1269` | `0.2503` | `0.5000` | `0.7499` | **`0.997`** |
| 10 | 107.0 | `0.1288` | `0.2520` | `0.5036` | `0.7508` | `1.015` |
| 13 | 80.6 | `0.1262` | `0.2501` | `0.4978` | `0.7503` | **`0.993`** |
| 14 | 73.6 | `0.1262` | `0.2523` | `0.4980` | `0.7488` | `0.997` |

Every entry is `r / n` to three decimals. The paired contrast against the
random-orthonormal null, studentised-`t`:

| `r` | `mean(contain - null)` | 95% `t` interval |
|---:|---:|---|
| 128 | `+0.00216` | `[+0.00040, +0.00392]` |
| 256 | `+0.00184` | `[-0.00019, +0.00387]` |
| 512 | `+0.00056` | `[-0.00143, +0.00255]` |
| 768 | `+0.00066` | `[-0.00115, +0.00248]` |

At `r = 128` the excess over random is **two tenths of one percentage point** —
detectable at `n = 8` and worth nothing. Everywhere else it is indistinguishable
from zero, and at three cells it is **below** the null.

**`G-CONTAIN` FAILS at every gated layer** (`t`-lower bounds `-0.25` to `-0.31`),
and **the contract's falsifier — *"containment at or below the random-orthonormal
null at any `r`"* — FIRED.** By the pre-registered rule the free selector is dead
and `C3` is not built.

**The suspicious cleanliness was checked, not assumed.** A containment of exactly
`r/n` is what a *broken* range finder would also produce, and the most plausible
break was real: WP13 measured `r90(Sigma)` collapsing `237 -> 26` on the
**post-ReLU** covariance, while this hook builds `Q` at the **linear** step from
`cov_pre = W^T Sigma W`, and `W^T (.) W` might have re-spread the spectrum. I
measured it, in pure K2 on CPU, before believing the result:

| layer | `r90(cov_post)` | `r90(cov_pre)` | `r99(cov_post)` | `r99(cov_pre)` |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 239 | 246 | 581 | 482 |
| 7 | 60 | 64 | 174 | 174 |
| 14 | 30 | 32 | 90 | 92 |

**The hypothesis was wrong and the instrument is clean.** `cov_pre` is as
rank-collapsed as `cov_post`. The range finder was fed a genuinely low-rank
covariance and still found nothing. Independent support: `S-RF` orthonormality
`3.8e-07`, `S-CONT` returns `1.000000005` inside `span(Q)` and `1.7e-15` in its
complement, `r = 1024` returns exactly `1.0000`, and the **cross-network null**
(`Q` from a *different* network's `Sigma`, identical code path) is
indistinguishable from the random one at every cell.

> **The finding, stated as strongly as the data allows:** `E21` is strongly low
> rank (`r90` `264 -> 74`) and `Sigma` is strongly low rank (`r90` `239 -> 30`),
> both in the same flow, at the same layers, driven by the same weights — and
> **their subspaces are related no more than chance.** Two structured objects,
> orthogonally structured.

## 4. `C2` — **G-E2E FAILS and its falsifier FIRES**; `G-POS` PASSES

The first end-to-end run of a rank-`r` in-flight correction this project has ever
done. Paired drift against the uncapped flow, 8 networks, `f32`.

| cell | mean drift | `x` better | `t`-lower on the `x`-fold contrast |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `none` (uncorrected regenerating arm) | `8.7545e-07` | `1.000` | — |
| `proj:0` (determinism check) | `8.7545e-07` | `1.000` | bit-identical |
| `e3` — exact `(3,)` residual, an `n`-VECTOR | `5.6458e-07` | **`1.551`** | `1.48` |
| `proj:128` | `8.1895e-07` | `1.069` | `1.04` |
| `proj:512` | `6.3328e-07` | `1.382` | `1.31` |
| `proj:1024` (= exact `E21`, no `E3`) | `3.4546e-07` | `2.534` | `2.39` |
| `svd:512` (best possible rank-512 subspace) | `3.4804e-07` | `2.515` | `2.36` |
| `e3proj:512` | `3.1506e-07` | `2.779` | `2.58` |
| `exact` (both slices) | `8.5335e-14` | `1.0e+07` | — |

- **`G-E2E` FAILS.** `d_i = drift_none - 5 * drift_proj512` has mean `-2.29e-06`,
  95% `t` `[-2.48e-06, -2.10e-06]`. **The `< 2x` falsifier FIRED**: `proj:512`
  buys `1.382x`.
- **`G-POS` PASSES**, exactly as pre-registered. Exact injection of both slices
  reproduces the uncapped flow to drift `8.53e-14` against a final-layer mean
  square of `0.7914` — **relative `1.08e-13`**, inside the `<= 1e-12` clause.
  **P7 HELD.** So the premise the whole lane rests on — that the scored means read
  `kappa_3` only through its two repeated slices — is now *demonstrated end to end
  at the live shape*, not argued.
- **`S2-1024` PASSES BIT-IDENTICAL.** The load-bearing null `SKEPTIC WP13`
  recorded as outstanding — it had only ever run at `256 x 4` — now runs at
  `1024 x 16`. **That debt is discharged.**
- **P8 HELD.** Drift falls monotonically in `r` (`1.069, 1.169, 1.382, 1.765,
  2.534`) and never rises. **The injection is not destructive**, unlike WP10's
  variance channel — the mechanism I gave (correcting the same object the closure
  truncates, toward the exact flow) survives.
- **P10 HELD.** The `(3,)`-slice residual alone buys `1.551x` (predicted
  `>= 1.3x`) and it is an `n`-vector: in a regenerating flow it is a vector added
  to `S3` before `M = diag(S3) + 3 S21^T` is rebuilt, `O(n)` per layer, far below
  the `1e8`-FLOP clause. **It is the cheapest accuracy this project has found.**
  It is still an ORACLE — nothing here predicts `E3` from the flow's own state.

**And the decomposition, which is the part worth carrying forward.** Correcting
`(2,1)` exactly and leaving `(3,)` wrong gives `2.53x`; correcting `(3,)` exactly
and leaving `(2,1)` wrong gives `1.55x`. The two residual drifts are roughly
additive (`3.45e-07 + 5.65e-07 = 9.1e-07` against a total `8.75e-07`), so **about
`40%` of the regenerating flow's error enters through the `(3,)` slice and about
`60%` through `(2,1)`.** Both must be corrected; neither alone gets past `2.5x`.

`svd:512` (`2.515x`) and `proj:1024` (`2.534x`, exact `E21`) agree to `0.8%`, so
**`E21` really is rank-512-sufficient** — the residual after the best rank-512
truncation contributes almost nothing. That is WP13's `E2` confirmed end to end
and without the `eps^2` model. **What is missing is only the ability to FIND that
subspace**, and `C1` has now closed the last cheap candidate for it.

**Six held, three refuted, two not run.** Every refutation is in the *pessimistic*
direction on accuracy and the one exact hit (P1) is on cost. That asymmetry is
itself the slice's summary.

## 6. What this does to the plan

**`C4` is not run, and this is a decision, not an omission.** Its gate `G-FLOOR`
required total `<= 219,885,548,339` counted FLOPs; `C0-iii` measured
`167,919,171,072` before `C4` existed. The low-rank backbone was the route to the
floor and the floor is already reached, so building it would buy headroom for a
correction that `C1` and `C2` have just shown we cannot construct. The gate stands
as written, unscored, and `C4` is re-opened only if a correction is ever found
that needs the room. **P11 and P12 are recorded NOT RUN rather than quietly
dropped.**

**What is CLOSED, on measurement:** the free selector — `Sigma`'s dominant range
does not contain `E21`'s. Together with WP13's five column-weight selectors, the
two cheapest families of selector are now both measured dead.

**What is OPEN and must not be recorded as closed:** `E21` is rank-512-sufficient
end to end, the `(3,)` residual is an `n`-vector worth `1.55x` for free, and the
two slices are the *only* channel to the scored means (`G-POS`, `1.08e-13`). The
information is there and it is cheap to carry. **No known map from the flow's own
state to it.**

**Where we stand against the board.** At the `0.1` floor the score is `raw / 10`:

| | raw | adjusted | vs Puffi `4.5e-09` |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| board leader (Puffi) | — | `4.5e-09` | `1.00x` |
| full factorized K3 **if it fit the floor** | `3.9e-08` | `3.9e-09` | **`1.15x` better** |
| full K3 at its own measured f32 price (`1.0723 B`) | `3.9e-08` | `4.2e-08` | `9.3x` worse |
| **regenerating flow at the floor** | `8.5e-07` | `8.5e-08` | `19x` worse |
| graded v2.7 (shipped) | `1.37e-06` | `1.37e-07` | `31x` worse |

*(The `1.0723 B` W-EFF figure was checked before being used here and is **already
an f32 measurement** — `experiments/2026-08-28_weff/weff_price_f32_*.json`, f64
`2.1446 B`. It does not halve again, and W-EFF stays closed on its own screen.)*

> **The whole competition, for us, is now one sentence: full-K3 accuracy is worth
> first place, and it costs `10.7x` the floor. The regenerating flow buys the cost
> and loses `21x` of the accuracy. Everything since WP11 has been an attempt to
> bridge that gap, and WP13 and WP14 have between them closed both cheap bridges
> on measurements.**

## 7. Knowledge delta

1. **Two low-rank objects in the same computation need not share a subspace.** It
   is tempting — and this contract's whole hypothesis — to reason that if `Sigma`
   collapses and `E21` collapses and both are driven by the same weights, the
   collapses must be aligned. They are related no more than chance, at every depth.
   The mechanism offered in H1 (Hadamard products spread spectrum) predicted
   *partial* alignment and was too generous by exactly the alignment.
2. **A result that is too clean deserves a cheap independent check before it is
   believed, and the check should be able to come back either way.** Containment
   of exactly `r/n` is what a broken range finder returns. The discriminator —
   `r90(cov_pre)` against `r90(cov_post)` — cost fifteen seconds of CPU, was chosen
   because it would have exposed a real bug, and refuted my own suspicion.
3. **The `(3,)` slice was never examined and carries `40%` of the error.** Eleven
   closed lanes and two contracts all went after the `n x n` off-diagonal object.
   The `n`-vector beside it is `1.55x` for `O(n)`, and it was never a cell in any
   experiment until this one.
4. **A self-test can be worth a whole slice.** `S-IDEM` cost two minutes on CPU and
   changed `C2`'s mechanism before a single GPU-hour was spent; without it every
   cell would have measured two truncations while reporting one.
5. **`SKEPTIC WP13`'s process rules were binding and all four paid.** Thresholds in
   the scoring unit forced `C0-iii` into existence, which is the best result here.
   Code-path-distinct nulls gave `C1` the random and cross-network bases that make
   its negative unambiguous. `>= 8` nets and `artifact=` at claim time both held.
   The `f64` control is the one still in flight.

# 2026-09-02 — SKEPTIC WP14: CLAIM A **PROVISIONAL**, CLAIM B **ACCEPT**

Eighth independent pass this project; eighth to find something real. Every
finding below was re-verified in-tree before acceptance.

## What it verified, independently and by its own instruments

- **Pre-registration order, mechanically.** `d915f83` touches **one file**,
  `experiments/LOG.md`, `+289` lines, nothing else; every result commit is later;
  every instrument first appears after the contract; **no gate moved** — the
  scorer applies `0.60 / 0.80 / 1.5x null`, the `5x` contrast, the `2x` falsifier
  and the `1e-12` clause exactly as written.
- **Protected paths: zero functional diff** over `36312c3..HEAD` on
  `estimator.py`, `experiments/vault/`, `competition_score.py`, `seed_blocks.py`,
  `seed_ledger.py`, `p2_pb_rank.py`, `p2_slice_lab.py`, `HUMAN_MODEL.md`.
  `seed_ledger --check` exits 0; the truth sha256 matches the ledger record byte
  for byte; the DESIGN overlap is recorded with its correlated-evidence warning.
- **The dtype rate table and both cost arms**, re-executed to a scratch path:
  `198,233,321,472` / `99,116,660,736`, **to the FLOP**.
- **The injection algebra**, derived by hand from `_factored_get_dslice` — the
  `(2,1)` block-perms, the `zero_repeated` kill, the `1/3` coefficient, and the
  necessity of zeroing `d21`'s diagonal. All confirmed.

## CLAIM B (accuracy) — ACCEPT, and it built the control I should have built

**`range_finder` was never tested against the property its name asserts.** `S-RF`
tests only orthonormality and **`S-CONT` uses `random_basis`, not
`range_finder`** — so nothing anywhere checked that `Q` spans `Sigma`'s dominant
range. The review wrote that positive control and ran it at the live shape:

| pre-layer | `r90(Sigma)` | `Q` at `r=128` | `r=256` | `r=512` |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2 (L1) | 187 | `0.99993` | `0.99754` | `0.9999994` |
| 8 (L7) | 55 | `0.9999248` | `0.99999997` | `0.9999999` |
| 15 (L14) | 25 | `0.9999999` | `0.9999999` | `1.0000000` |

`range_finder` returns `Sigma`'s dominant range essentially exactly. **So `r/n` is
a property of `E21`, not of a degenerate basis.** It also refuted the "wrong
matrix" hypothesis by a different route than mine (`K[2]` is an `HTensor` with
`r = 0`, `max|Sigma - Sigma^T| = 0.0` exactly, eigenvalues `[2.04e-05, 8.02]`),
and **independently re-implemented the whole containment statistic at `256 x 16`**
— a width nobody had measured — in f32 and f64, reproducing `r/n` with the
positive control at `1.0` in the same run.

**This is the check I did not run.** Mine (`p2_cov_spectra.py`) asked whether the
covariance was the right *object*; it never asked whether `Q` was the right
*basis*. The lesson is narrow: **when a negative rests on an instrument, test the
instrument against the property it is named for, not against a nearby one.**

## CLAIM A (cost) — PROVISIONAL, and the challenge is fair

The review priced what upstream's **real** regenerating flow costs, by torch
dispatch census and by upstream's own `NamedFlopCounter` bins, at `512 x 16`:
**`19.4` n^3-matmul-equivalents per layer**, against the projection's `2.00` (K2)
`+ 2.89` (K3) `= 4.89`. It then **derived the structural argument independently
and confirmed it** — no cross-block terms in the concatenated-factor Hadamard,
`A2 == A3` collapsing three block permutations to two, the `3I` middle leg making
the two-leg block `O(n^2)`, the identity legs making `contract_W` one matmul — and
found the other 24 kept terms really are `0.13` matmul-equivalents/layer total.

**But it has never executed**, and the margin is `1.51` matmuls/layer: *one*
un-reducible extra `n^3` op per layer fits inside the `51.98e9` spare, **two do
not.** Two named live traps the projection does not price: flopscope promotes
`stats.norm.cdf/pdf` from f32 to f64 (it cost `2x` on the K2 arm before two
`.astype` calls fixed it), and `p2_slice_cost.py`'s spelling is admitted
numerically wrong, so "cost-correct" is asserted rather than tested against a
correct implementation.

**Accepted in full.** `docs/CURRENT_STATE.md` led with *"THE COST HALF IS
SOLVED"* three lines above its own PROJECTION paragraph; it now reads **"SOLVED
ON ARITHMETIC AND NOT YET ON EXECUTION"** and points at this verdict.

## Six defects, all confirmed and all repaired

1. **`p2_range_lab.py` contradicted itself in one committed file.** Line 55 said
   `G-POS` is *"unchanged from the contract"*; line 361 said the `exact` cell
   *"is no longer a positive control"*. Both landed in `aa01fdd` — my `patch2.py`
   fixed one site and not the other. **Repaired**; the durable record now says one
   thing.
2. **`G-POS`'s normaliser was unpinned, and the two readings disagree on the
   verdict.** `drift / mean_square` gives `1.078e-13` (**PASS**, `9x` margin);
   the RMS reading this same file uses for `S-IDEM` gives `3.28e-07` (**FAIL** —
   and a `G-POS` failure voids `C2` and `C3`). The MSE reading is the literal one
   and `3.28e-07` is about 3 ulps of f32, but a gate that can void two cells must
   not rest on an unstated convention. **Repaired**: `p2_wp14_score.py` now loads
   the truth, computes `mean(truth_final^2) = 0.791444`, prints `1.0782e-13
   PASS`, and prints the RMS reading beside it.
3. **The committed scorer did not reproduce the LOG's `G-POS` number** — it
   printed a bare ratio to the uncorrected arm and the word `"see note"`.
   Repaired with (2).
4. **`24.2` f32 matmuls is `1.51` per layer, not `1.61`.** I divided by 15 layers
   where there are 16. Corrected in `p2_k3_fnp.py` (with the reason in a comment)
   and in `CURRENT_STATE.md`.
5. **`68,802,510,336` exists in no artifact on disk** — only in prose, in three
   documents. Its provenance is real (a 2026-08-26 grader-spelling measurement,
   five shapes, nine networks bit-identical, independently ACCEPTed) and it is
   the **largest** of the three nearby figures, so the direction is conservative.
   Recorded as an open provenance gap; the `fnp` port is what closes it.
6. **"1.61x better than v2.7" is an unpaired, cross-sample, cross-instrument
   ratio of means**, when a paired statistic was available from the same
   artifact. The review's paired reconstruction gives **`1.542x`**, paired
   arithmetic difference `4.608e-08`, t95 `[2.409e-08, 6.807e-08]`, **8/8 wins**.
   **Repaired**: `p2_truth_score.py` gains a `v27proxy` arm (our closure x v2.7's
   sixteen gains, labelled a proxy) and reports the paired arithmetic difference
   with both a studentised-`t` and a basic-bootstrap interval; re-run submitted.

## What it did not overturn

`C4` not run is **defensible**, not a dropped gate: `G-FLOOR`'s FLOP clause was
met before `C4` existed, the gate is left unscored rather than moved, `P11`/`P12`
are recorded NOT RUN, and nothing anywhere depends on `C4`. The `2^22` truth
resolution is adequate (cross-product sampling sd ~`0.9%` of the regen arm). The
alignment worry (point 4) is structurally impossible here — `ref` and `got` are
keyed on the same loop index in two runs of the same `run_flow` on the same
object, and `Sigma` is captured in the *same hook call* as `own_s21`.

## The cheapest discriminating follow-up, named and NOT run

**For CLAIM A, and it is scoped far smaller than finishing the port:** execute
**one layer** of the regenerating K3 step in `fnp` at `n = 1024` — the `(1,1,1)`
block, all 25 kept `pK` terms and the harmonic projection at `d = 3, 4` — inside
a real `BudgetContext` at float32, with the `.astype(float32)` cast-back after
every `flops.stats.*` call, and read the meter. No seeds, no truth, no GPU,
seconds of CPU. **It converts the load-bearing `2.89`-matmuls-per-layer
structural argument into a measurement and either confirms the floor or moves the
multiplier.** That is the next action, ahead of the rest of the port.

## Knowledge delta

1. **Test an instrument against the property it is NAMED for.** `S-RF` checked
   orthonormality and `S-CONT` checked the containment statistic using a
   *different* basis constructor, so between them they left the one claim
   `range_finder` exists to make — that `Q` spans `Sigma`'s dominant range —
   unchecked. The negative happened to survive. It did not have to.
2. **A number that lives only in prose is not evidence, however well reviewed.**
   `68,802,510,336` was measured, reviewed and accepted, and is in no artifact.
   Half the headline rests on it.
3. **A gate needs its normaliser written down.** `G-POS` PASSES by `9x` under one
   reading of "relative final-layer MSE" and FAILS under another, and a failure
   would have voided two cells.
4. **Correcting one of two coupled channels saturates.** `svd:256` on the `(2,1)`
   slice alone caps at `2.4x`; adding the free `(3,)` vector takes the same rank
   to `32x`. Neither channel's marginal value is visible while the other is
   wrong — which is exactly the shape of WP10's finding about the mean and
   variance channels, now seen a second time in a different pair.

# 2026-09-02 — SKEPTIC WP14's FOLLOW-UP EXECUTED: **THE FLOOR SURVIVES EXECUTION**, and the projection was 3.3% optimistic

`SKEPTIC WP14` rated CLAIM A (the `0.07636 B` floor) **PROVISIONAL** for one
stated reason — *"two spellings that have never been executed as one program"* —
and named the cheapest discriminating follow-up by hand:

> execute **one layer** of the regenerating K3 step in `fnp` at `n = 1024` — the
> `(1,1,1)` block, all 25 kept `pK` terms and the harmonic projection at
> `d = 3, 4` — inside a real `BudgetContext` at float32, with the
> `.astype(float32)` cast-back after every `flops.stats.*` call, and read the
> meter.

That is now done, exactly as specified. **No seed block was drawn, no truth was
minted, no gate is scored on it, and no accuracy claim rests on it.** It is a
price, and it moves a number that was arithmetic into a number that is a
measurement.

## The instrument

`local_sim/p2_k3_fnp.py --layer-price` and `--layer-k2`, with the port's
combinatorics frozen out of upstream by a new generator
`local_sim/p2_k3_coefs.py` → `experiments/2026-09-02_wp14_fnp/k3_coefs_simple.json`.
The same bounded-port discipline as the term table: **every table in it depends
on nothing but the partition combinatorics** — not on `n`, not on the weights,
not on the data — so it is enumerated once against upstream rev `93d091a4` and
re-checkable. Four tables:

| table | what | size |
|---|---|---|
| `terms` | the 25 kept SIMPLE terms as an executable program: which slices multiply, the folded scalar, the per-axis Wick indices | 25 rows |
| `pK_to_K` | `DS_part_sum`'s vector partitions with `vec_part_coef * _pK_to_K_coef` already folded | 19 rows over 7 slices |
| `lap2_d4` | `_lap_m_dslice(m=2)` for the two `d = 4` slices | 2 rows |
| `wick` | the 16 `(k, p)` ReLU Wick coefficients, split into the three `relu_wick_coef` branches, with `_relu_wick_poly`'s polynomials frozen | 16 rows |

`proj_coef(n, 4, 2)` is deliberately **not** frozen — it is a closed form in `n`
and is evaluated, so a width change cannot silently invalidate it.

**One structural fact the port makes concrete, and it is why `K[4]` is nearly
free:** `get_r_x(4, k_max=3, SIMPLE) = 2`, so `K[4]` is an `HTensor` with radial
index 2 and a core of order `4 - 2*2 = 0`. **The fourth cumulant this flow
carries is one scalar per network per layer.** Both surviving Laplacian
multigraphs cap every leg; the `(3,1)` and `(2,1,1)` slices admit no multigraph
meeting their arity condition and contribute exactly zero, so the `n^3` object
`(2,1,1)` that upstream materialises is not formed here at all.

## THE MEASUREMENT — `experiments/2026-09-02_wp14_fnp/layer_price_1024.json`

One full layer (linear step **and** nonlinear step) at `1024`, executed as ONE
program, metered:

| | counted FLOPs | dense `1024`-matmuls | `/ n^3` |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `f64` | `21,675,713,540` | `5.047` | `20.187` |
| **`f32`** | **`10,837,935,618`** | **`5.047`** | `10.094` |

> **`f32 / f64 = 0.50000` exactly.** Nothing promoted. The dtype audit checked
> **56 arrays**, found **0 violations**, and recorded both `flops.stats.*` calls
> returning `float64` from a `float32` input and being cast back — the trap
> `SKEPTIC WP14` named, instrumented rather than asserted.

| | FLOPs | `x budget` |
|---|---:|---:|
| this layer `x 16` | `173,406,969,888` | **`0.07886 B`** |
| the projection it replaces (`68,802,510,336 + 99,116,660,736`) | `167,919,171,072` | `0.07636 B` |
| ratio measured / projected | | **`1.0327`** |
| the `0.1` floor | `219,902,325,555` | `0.1` |
| **headroom** | `46,495,355,667` | **`0.02114 B`** = `1.35` f32 matmuls/layer |

**The floor holds.** `CLAIM A`'s conclusion survives its own execution test. But
the projection was **3.3% optimistic** and the margin narrows from `1.51` to
`1.35` f32 matmuls per layer.

**Where the 3.3% went, and it is the honest answer to the one thing the two
separately-measured halves could not charge for.** `5.047` measured against
`4.89` projected (`2.00` K2 + `2.89` K3) is `0.157` dense matmuls per layer of
`O(n^2)` work that neither half ever paid: the 25 `pK` terms, the 16 Wick
coefficients, the `pK -> K` conversion, the `d = 4` harmonic projection, the
`M = diag(S3) + 3 S21^T` rebuild and the diagonal masks. `SKEPTIC WP14` estimated
that residue structurally at `0.13` matmul-equivalents per layer. **It is
`0.157`.** The structural argument was right and slightly generous to itself.

**What the `x 16` is, precisely.** It replicates a STEADY-STATE layer sixteen
times, which is conservative in three named ways and incomplete in three others.
Conservative: layer 0 enters with `cov = I` and `M = 0` and a real estimator
skips work there; the last layer needs neither the two `(2,1)`-slice matmuls nor
the `M` rebuild; and the `off_mask` build is charged once per layer here where a
flow builds it once. Incomplete: it excludes the readout and assembly of the
`(depth, width)` answer, any calibration, and `setup()`. It also says nothing
about `whest validate`, the 4 GiB single-array rule, the 8 GiB cap or the 0.4 s
residual cliff. The `+2**24` server offset is not applied because `0.0789` is not
within `0.5%` of the floor; adding it anyway moves nothing (`0.078863`).

## The price is a price OF SOMETHING — three checks, `--layer-k2`

A FLOP count on an op sequence that computes nothing is worthless, and full
parity against upstream needs torch (`NOT_DONE` step 6, still open). These are
the checks that do not. Set `M = 0` and `c4 = 0`: every term carrying a `(3,)`,
`(4,)`, `(2,1)` or `(2,2)` block dies and the answer is known in closed form.
`experiments/2026-09-02_wp14_fnp/layer_k2_collapse.json`, at `256`:

| check | `f64` | `f32` |
|---|---:|---:|
| **A** mean vs the shipped K2 closure | `0.000e+00` | `0.000e+00` |
| **A** variance vs the K2 closure | `4.94e-16` | `2.41e-07` |
| **B** covariance vs K2 **plus the `k_max=3` edge term** | `5.13e-16` | `2.59e-07` |
| **C** `kappa_1` vs Gauss-Legendre quadrature | `2.89e-15` | `4.62e-08` |
| **C** `kappa_2` vs quadrature | `5.94e-15` | `2.14e-07` |
| **C** `kappa_3` diagonal vs quadrature | **`1.07e-14`** | `1.43e-06` |

**B is the check that would have caught a silently dropped term.** The
`k_max = 3` covariance is *not* the K2 covariance: `pK(1,1)` keeps two live
blocks, `Phi_i Phi_j C_ij` **and** `0.5 w(2)_i w(2)_j C_ij^2`. The second is
`5.49e-03` of the first here, and the check requires it to be **present** —
a layer that reproduced bare K2 exactly would be wrong, and would have passed a
naive "does it match K2" test. It agrees with K2-plus-that-term to `5e-16`.

**C is independent of the port's own machinery**: numerical integration rather
than the Wick/Hermite closed forms, exercising the `p = 1, 2, 3` polynomial
branches, the 25-term loop, the frozen scalars, the `pK -> K` coefficients
`(+2, -3, +1)` and the `M` rebuild in one shot. Agreement to `1.07e-14`.

## Two defects found in this session's own instrument, before it was believed

1. **A NaN reference passed a `>` gate silently.** The first version of check C
   used `numpy.polynomial.hermite.hermgauss(400)`, whose weights **overflow to
   NaN** past degree ~200. `nan > tol` is `False`, so all three quadrature
   comparisons printed `nan` and the verdict printed **PASS**. Repaired: any
   non-finite value is a failure, and the quadrature refuses rather than
   returning non-finite nodes. *This is the second time this exact class has
   appeared here* — WP8's residual soak sorted never-executed rows to the bottom
   of a median. **A comparison operator is not a check; it silently admits the
   one value it cannot order.**
2. **Gauss-Hermite is the wrong rule for a ReLU expectation, and it failed as a
   REFERENCE, not as the thing under test.** `max(z, 0)` has a kink at the
   origin, so Gauss-Hermite converges algebraically: at degree 160 it disagreed
   with the exact `sigma phi(alpha) + mu Phi(alpha)` by `1.1e-03` — an error that
   reads exactly like a bug in the port. Splitting the integral at the kink and
   using Gauss-Legendre on `[max(mu, 0), max(mu, 0) + 14 sigma]` leaves an
   analytic integrand and lands at `3e-15`. Recorded in `docs/GOTCHAS.md`.

## Knowledge delta

1. **The composed floor survives execution: `0.07886 B` measured against
   `0.07636 B` projected, `1.0327x`.** `SKEPTIC WP14`'s PROVISIONAL on CLAIM A is
   discharged for the per-layer arithmetic, and NOT for the rest of what it
   named — `whest validate`, the memory gate, the residual soak and an
   end-to-end candidate are all still ahead.
2. **The margin is `1.35` f32 matmuls per layer, not `1.51`.** One un-reducible
   extra `n^3` op per layer still fits; two still do not. The oracle rank-512
   correction (`16,106,127,360` f32 FLOPs = `0.0073 B`) fits `2.9x` over inside
   the new margin, down from `3.2x`.
3. **`K[4]` in this flow is one scalar per layer.** `r = 2` with an order-0 core.
   Any design that budgeted for a fourth-order `n^2` or `n^3` object was
   budgeting for something that does not exist here.
4. **A number that lives only in prose is now in an artifact.** `SKEPTIC WP14`
   defect (5) recorded that `68,802,510,336` appears in no file on disk. It is
   now superseded by a metered end-to-end figure that does.

# 2026-09-02 — **THE CHANGE GATE HAS BEEN RED SINCE `3b28796`, AND NOTHING WAS WRONG WITH THE LEDGER**

Found while running `scripts/preflight.ps1` before today's port work. Steps **7**
and **9** both **FAIL**, and they have failed since commit `3b38796` — through
the WP14 results commit, the Skeptic pass, the paired re-score and two
`CURRENT_STATE` updates. **Four commits were made on a red gate.** IMPORTANT.

## The cause, and it is one unset field

`SKEPTIC WP13` required that a claim name its artifact at claim time. WP14 C0-i
did that, and its claim note says, in words:

> *"DELIBERATE DESIGN-tier overlap with the p2_slice_lab.py claim of the same
> range — C1's containment result and WP13's spectra are CORRELATED evidence and
> must never be quoted as independent."*

**The intent went into `note`. The field the enforcement layer reads is
`paired_with`, and it was left empty.** So `test_seed_ledger.py`'s check *"A1:
exactly ONE accidental collision in the whole record"* correctly saw two,
correctly refused, and correctly turned the gate red — about a ledger that is,
substantively, entirely correct.

Two separate defects, and the second is the one that matters:

1. **`paired_with` can only be set at claim time, and the second consumer of a
   deliberate overlap is not known when the first claims.** There was no way to
   declare an overlap deliberate after the fact except to edit an append-only
   record. So the only available spelling of the truth was prose, and prose is
   invisible to the gate.
2. **The check was a SNAPSHOT wearing the clothes of a property.** *"Exactly ONE
   accidental collision"* is a count of a growing record, and the file's own
   comment fourteen lines below it makes exactly this argument about a different
   assertion — that a snapshot *"would have turned preflight RED at the exact
   moment the block was used as designed, and the only way forward would have
   been to edit the gate."* **That is what happened, to the assertion sitting
   directly above the warning.**

## The repair

- **`seed_ledger.py` gains a third record kind, `"pair"`** — a machine-readable,
  append-only declaration that two consumers on a range overlapped deliberately,
  carrying its own reason. It is not a consumption and is excluded from overlap
  and SINGLE_USE accounting exactly as `finalize` is. `declare_pair()` **refuses
  to license an overlap that does not exist in the record**, so it cannot be used
  to pre-authorise anything.
- **The report no longer picks between two canned tags.** The old binary printed
  either *"SAME NETWORKS BY DESIGN"* or *"CORRELATED EVIDENCE"* — and the P01
  case is **both**: reusing WP13's eight networks was a choice, and the two
  results still must never be quoted as independent. A canned *"one experiment,
  two roles"* would have erased the warning. **A pair record's own note is now
  the tag**, so the ledger says what the person who declared it said.
- **The P01 pairing is declared**, with the correlation warning inside it.
- **`test_seed_ledger.py`'s A1 becomes a property**: every *undeclared* overlap
  must be on a named list with its reason (today: the one D16 accident of
  2026-08-10). A new accident still fires; a newly *declared* overlap does not.
  Two checks added: that the P01 declaration still carries the word CORRELATED,
  and that `declare_pair` refuses a fabricated pairing. **62/62.**
- The `P03` seed constant that second check needs is **read from the registry,
  not written as a literal** — a seed-shaped constant in that file is exactly
  what the source scan exists for, and widening the exclusion pragma to silence
  it would have blunted the scan to make a test pass.
- `preflight.ps1` and `VALIDATION.md` §7 relabelled `60/60 -> 62/62`, which is
  `test_enforcement_labels.py` doing its job.

## Knowledge delta

1. **Intent recorded in prose is not recorded.** The WP14 C0-i claim said
   "DELIBERATE" in English and "accidental" in the schema, and the schema is what
   runs. **If a rule is machine-checked, the exception has to be machine-declared
   too** — otherwise the only way past the check is to weaken it.
2. **A count of a growing record is never a property.** This is the fifth check
   this repository has lost to that pattern and the first where the warning was
   already written in the same function.
3. **A red gate did not stop four commits.** Nothing enforces "preflight was
   green" at commit time — the pre-commit hook guards protected paths, not the
   gate. That is a real hole and it is NOT repaired here; it is recorded as open.
   The cheapest fix is a `preflight --since <commit>` marker the pre-commit hook
   can read, and it needs its own slice.

# 2026-09-02 — CONTRACT (Rule 1): **WP15 — THE MAP**. STRATEGIC. Pre-registered before any data exists.

*Committed before any WP15 instrument is run and before `P05` or `P06` is
touched. Twelve numbered predictions, five of which predict a gate in this
contract failing. **The human prediction slot is WAIVED** — Samuel is solo and
the strategist directing this arc has already recorded its own position, which
is quoted below and which I disagree with in two places.*

## Question

**Is there a map from the regenerating flow's own carried state `(mu, Sigma, S3,
S21)` to the rank-`r` correction of BOTH `kappa_3` read-slices?**

That is the whole of what is left. Everything else about this lane is measured:
the correction is worth first place, it is affordable, and nothing that merely
*selects* a subspace can find it.

## Evidence

| | status | source |
|---|---|---|
| Correcting **both** slices at oracle rank 512 gives **`333.8x`** end-to-end drift reduction; rank 128 gives `11.1x` | CONFIRMED | `gpuq` 131, `experiments/.../c2_e2e_oracle_rank.json` |
| Correcting **one** slice saturates at `2.4x` however good the correction | CONFIRMED | same |
| A rank-512 correction costs `16,106,127,360` counted f32 FLOPs = `0.0073 B` | CONFIRMED | WP14 C2 pricing |
| The regenerating flow, executed as ONE `fnp` program, costs `5.047` f32 `1024`-matmuls/layer = `0.07886 B` over 16 layers; **margin `0.02114 B` = `1.35` matmuls/layer** | CONFIRMED | today, `layer_price_1024.json` |
| `Sigma`'s dominant range contains `E21` exactly as much as a random subspace does (`r/n` to three decimals, every depth, every rank, f32 and f64, positive control at `1.0`) | CONFIRMED | WP14 C1 + `SKEPTIC WP14` |
| Five column-weight selectors are each `1.45x`-`2.10x` **worse** than not correcting | CONFIRMED | WP13 E1 |
| `kappa_3` locality: the single-layer share of the residual is `0.42`-`0.70` | CONFIRMED | WP4 |
| The uncorrected flow is raw `8.5075e-07`, `1.637x` better than the v2.7 proxy, 8 of 8 networks | CONFIRMED | WP14 C0-i paired |
| **The freshly generated all-distinct block's own contribution to the next `(2,1)` slice is `w(1)_i^2 w(2)_j (C_ij)^2`** — an `n x n` Hadamard of the covariance with itself under two diagonal scalings, with **no `n^3` object anywhere in it** | CONFIRMED **today**, in code | `p2_k3_fnp.k3_layer`, block 2; `factor_k3.py:378-403` |
| Composed-excess models over-predict the end-to-end effect by ~`32x` | CONFIRMED | WP10 |
| A map has never been tried. WP13 killed selectors on the carried tensor; WP14 killed `Sigma`'s range | CONFIRMED | both |

## Hypothesis and mechanism

**The information the regenerating flow throws away is generated, each layer, by
a closed-form function of `(mu, Sigma)` — and that function is a Hadamard, not a
contraction.**

The mechanism is now written down rather than argued. At each layer the
nonlinearity creates a fresh all-distinct `kappa_3` block as a rank-`n` factored
tensor `(fac1, 3 I, fac3^T)` with

    fac1 = w(1)[:, None] * C ,   fac3 = (w(2)[:, None] * w(1)[None, :] * C).T

where `C` is the zero-diagonal pre-activation covariance and `w(k)` are the ReLU
Wick coefficients the flow already computes. Its **middle leg is a multiple of
the identity**, so every block permutation of its `(2,1)` slice degenerates to a
row scaling and the whole contribution is `fac1 . fac3 = w(1)_i^2 w(2)_j C_ij^2`.
The regenerating flow keeps that contribution for one layer and then **discards
the factored block at the `from_dstensor` rebuild** — which is exactly the
`E21` it is missing.

So the missing correction is not an arbitrary function of the state. Its leading
term is a **specific quadratic Hadamard in `Sigma` under diagonal scalings by
functions of `(mu, sigma)`** — and that is a member of Arm L's proposed basis by
construction, and Arm M's object by construction. **That is why a map can exist
where a selector cannot: a selector can only choose a subspace of something the
flow already holds, and the flow does not hold this at all.**

Two arms discriminate the two ways that could be true.

## Arm M — mechanistic. How deep is `E21`'s memory?

**Intervention.** Inject, into the regenerating flow, the EXACT all-distinct
contribution taken from the torch reference and selected BY AGE: the block
generated at `l-1` only; then `l-1` and `l-2`; then `l-1..l-3`. Report the
fraction of `E21`'s Frobenius energy explained per age, layer-averaged over
layers 4..14, on 16 networks from `P01`'s free range (DESIGN, structure only, no
gate scored on it).

**If short:** build "generate the fresh block from `(mu, Sigma)` in closed form,
contract it into the next slices, and carry a rank-`r` sketch (`r <= 128`) for
the residual memory". No fitting anywhere in it.

**The cost is the binding constraint and it is already computable.** Carrying the
fresh block EXACTLY for one extra layer turns `K[3]` into rank `2n`, which costs
`contract_W` two extra `n x n` matmuls and breaks the `A2 == A3` collapse in the
`(2,1)` slice (three distinct block permutations instead of two) — about **5
extra matmuls/layer against a margin of `1.35`. Exact carry is dead on
arithmetic before it is built.** A rank-`r` sketch replaces each of those with an
`(n x n)(n x r)` product costing `r / n` of a matmul; at `r = 128` the six of
them are `0.75` matmuls/layer and fit. **`r <= 192` is the affordability
horizon**, not `512`.

**Falsifier.** Memory is deep or diffuse — three ages together explain `< 70%` —
and Arm M is dead.

## Arm L — learned, supervised on the oracle

**Intervention.** The oracle correction `(E21, E3)` is a computable label from
full-K3 runs on minted networks. Fit

    E21 ~= sum_t c_t T_t(mu, Sigma, S21, sigma) ,   E3 ~= sum_t d_t v_t(mu, sigma, S3)

over a permutation-**equivariant** basis of at most **50 scalar coefficients** —
`Sigma . Sigma`, `Sigma . diag(g(mu, sigma)) . Sigma`, `S21 . D`, `diag(a) Sigma
diag(b)`, and the terms above — on `>= 128` networks from `P05`,
leave-networks-out. Then validate end to end **in flight** (the WP10 destructive-
injection check) on `P06`'s second half, and price it.

**Equivariance is not decoration.** The map must commute with a permutation of
the neurons, because the estimator's own answer does; a map that does not is
fitting neuron identities that do not survive to a fresh network, and that is the
mechanism by which every held-out score in this project has previously
evaporated.

**The learned component lives ONLY here.** The output/readout corrector stays
closed and this contract does not reopen it.

**Falsifier.** No transfer to fresh networks, or the in-flight injection is
destructive, and Arm L is dead.

## Gates — every threshold in flopscope FLOPs or in a paired statistic, fixed now

| gate | arm | threshold, fixed here |
|---|---|---|
| **G-M-DEPTH** | M | ages `{l-1, l-2}` explain **`>= 70%`** of `E21`'s Frobenius energy, layer-averaged over layers 4..14, on 16 networks. `< 70%` at all three ages **kills Arm M** |
| **G-M-COST** | M | the built arm's incremental counted **f32 flopscope** FLOPs over 16 layers at `1024` is **`<= 46,495,355,667`** (`0.02114 B`), MEASURED by `p2_k3_fnp`-style metering inside a real `BudgetContext`, never modelled |
| **G-M-E2E** | M | **`>= 10x`** end-to-end drift reduction vs the uncorrected regenerating flow on `P06[..000..063]`, paired arithmetic difference, studentised-`t` or basic-bootstrap 95% interval **excluding zero** |
| **G-L-FIT** | L | held-out `R^2` on `E21` **`>= 0.90`**, layer-averaged, leave-networks-out on `P05` |
| **G-L-COST** | L | identical to **G-M-COST**: `<= 46,495,355,667` f32 FLOPs. A basis of Hadamard-and-diagonal terms costs `~0.01` matmuls/layer; **each dense matmul-class term costs a full `2 n^3 = 2,146,435,072` FLOPs per layer**, so at most **ONE** such term fits |
| **G-L-E2E** | L | **`>= 10x`**, as G-M-E2E, on `P06[..064..127]` |
| **G-NULL** | both | a **permuted-coefficient** map and an **equal-rank random-basis** correction each give **`< 1.5x`** end to end. A null at `>= 1.5x` **voids that arm's measurement** rather than reducing it |

**Composition rule, named now:** `G-M-DEPTH` is **layer-averaged over layers
4..14**, not worst-layer and not all-layers. Layers 1-3 are excluded because the
flow has barely accumulated a `kappa_3` there and would flatter any short-memory
hypothesis; layer 15 is excluded because nothing downstream reads its `(2,1)`
slice.

## Statistic

Paired, on common random numbers, **arithmetic difference** in end-to-end drift
against full K3 and in final-layer MSE against minted truth, with a studentised-
`t` or basic-bootstrap 95% interval. **Never percentile, never BCa**
(measured false-promotion rates `6.8-8.2%` and `9.1-11.5%` against a nominal
`5%`). **Never a composed-excess model** — the `eps^2` amplitude over-predicts by
`32x`, and the only admissible statistic is the end-to-end one. `>= 8` networks
for a structure claim, `>= 100` for a fitting claim.

## Cost model — Phase 2, `lambda = 0`, so `C = F`

Counted **f32** flopscope FLOPs, MEASURED, in the same sentence as the dtype
(`float64 = 2.0`, `float32 = 1.0`). Residual is **not** a cost: it is a `0.4 s`
per-MLP cliff, reported as headroom `0.4 / observed` against the **worst**
observed run, from a **`gpuq`-brokered** soak, never a local absolute wall time.
The baseline the increments are measured against is today's
`173,406,969,888` f32 FLOPs (`0.07886 B`), and the `+2**24` server offset is
applied to any operating point within `0.5%` of the `0.1` floor.

**An f32 flow with an f64 control.** Every accuracy number is taken in both, as
WP14's `DTYPE-F64` control was, because this repository has already compared an
f64 cost to f32 accuracy once.

## Seed blocks — claimed through `seed_ledger`, never as literals

| role | block | tier | rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| Arm M memory-depth structure | `P01` free range, 16 | DESIGN | no gate; structure only |
| Arm L fit | **`P05`** (160, allocated today) | DESIGN | tuning PERMITTED here and nowhere else |
| Arm M end-to-end validation | **`P06[..000..063]`** | DESIGN | no tuning; read once |
| Arm L end-to-end validation | **`P06[..064..127]`** | DESIGN | no tuning; read once; DISJOINT from Arm M's half |
| the final comparison against v2.7 | `P04` | SINGLE_USE | **not touched by this contract** |

`artifact=` is named at `seed_ledger.claim()` time and closed with `finalize()`,
per `SKEPTIC WP13`'s process fix. **A deliberate overlap must set `paired_with`
or append a `pair` record** — the field, not a prose note. That is today's
finding and it is binding on this contract.

## Null controls — each differs in CODE PATH, not in a parameter

Binding, from both Skeptics: `eps = 0` is a determinism check, not a null.

1. **Permuted-coefficient map.** The fitted coefficients `c_t` are permuted
   across basis terms. Same arithmetic, same cost, same magnitudes, wrong
   assignment.
2. **Equal-rank random-basis correction.** A rank-`r` correction built from a
   random orthonormal basis with the oracle's own singular values, so it matches
   the real correction in rank and in energy and differs only in direction.
3. **Cross-network map.** The map fitted on network `i` applied to network `j`.

## Predictions — mine, numbered, with directions and magnitudes

| # | prediction |
|---|---|
| **P1** | `G-M-DEPTH`: age `l-1` alone explains **`>= 50%`** of `E21`; `{l-1, l-2}` **`>= 70%`**. Direction from WP4's `0.42-0.70` single-layer share. Refuted if `l-1` alone is `< 30%` |
| **P2** | The exact age-`(l-1)` contribution equals `w(1)_i^2 w(2)_j C_ij^2` (up to the rebuild's factor 3) with correlation **`>= 0.99`** against the injected reference. This is the mechanism check, and if it fails my reading of `factor_k3.py` is wrong and both arms rest on nothing. Refuted below `0.8` |
| **P3** | `G-M-COST`: a rank-128 one-step sketch costs **`<= 0.80`** f32 `1024`-matmuls/layer (`<= 0.0125 B` over 16 layers), inside the `0.02114 B` margin |
| **P4** | **`G-M-E2E` FAILS.** Arm M reaches `>= 5x` but `< 10x`. The oracle itself is only `11.1x` at rank 128 and a closed-form sketch is worse than an oracle. I put `~40%` on it clearing `10x` |
| **P5** | `G-L-FIT` per-layer: `R^2 >= 0.90` held out at layers 1-4, **`< 0.70`** at layers 10-14, and **layer-averaged `< 0.90`** — so **`G-L-FIT` FAILS as written**. The residual's rank collapses `264 -> 78` with depth while the covariance's collapses faster, so the map has less to work with exactly where the error accumulates |
| **P6** | **A per-layer `R^2` of `0.90` will NOT buy `10x` end to end.** Errors compound and the composed model over-predicts `32x`. Refuted if `>= 10x` is reached at layer-averaged `R^2 <= 0.90` |
| **P7** | All three nulls come in **`< 1.2x`**; `G-NULL` passes |
| **P8** | In-flight injection of the best fitted map is **monotone in `r` and NOT destructive**, unlike WP10's variance channel — as WP14's `P8` found for the oracle |
| **P9** | A Hadamard-and-diagonal-only basis costs **`<= 0.05`** matmuls/layer; each dense matmul term adds `1.00` |
| **P10** | **The `E3` half is the cheap half and will be fitted better than `E21`.** `E3` is an `n`-vector, correcting it alone already buys `1.551x` at `O(n)`, and I expect held-out `R^2 >= 0.95` on `E3` at every depth |
| **P11** | **Neither arm clears `10x` by the Sep 20 kill line.** `~55%`. If so we freeze and nominate the uncorrected regenerating flow plus v2.7 as the diverse pair |
| **P12** | The `f64` control changes nothing anywhere in WP15, as it changed nothing in WP14 (`0.127 / 0.128 / 0.128` identical to f32) |

**Where I disagree with the strategist, on the record and before the data.** The
brief says a rank-`128`-`512` sketch. **`512` is not affordable** — at `r = 512`
the sketch's extra products are `3.0` matmuls/layer against a `1.35` margin, and
the affordability horizon is `r <= 192`. And the brief's `>= 90%` held-out `R^2`
gate is, I predict, *not* the binding constraint: `P6` says the end-to-end
requirement will bite first, at an `R^2` the fit can reach.

## Baseline and control

The uncorrected regenerating flow at today's measured price, on the same
networks, common random numbers. Full K3 is the accuracy ceiling and the drift
reference. `v2.7` enters only through `P04`, which this contract does not touch.

## Confounders, scope, and what must not change

- `estimator.py` is not touched.
- `local_sim/p2_k3_fnp.py::k3_layer` is the chassis and **its price is frozen at

**~2026-09-20.** If neither arm reaches `>= 10x` end-to-end drift reduction on
