`docs/GAME_PLAN.md`: Stage 0 production-path repair and Stage 1 mathematical/cost
conformance. It changes instruments and probes, not `estimator.py`, frozen

1. **Certification domains/provenance.** Driving the real check emitters, rather
   than helper-only fixtures, will reproduce MATH misclassification for at least
   the combined cost section and section 11. Distribution metadata will recover
   both installed package versions. A legacy artifact with an applicable explicit
   failure will remain REFUSED after repair, while one merely lacking v3 binding
   fields will be INCOMPLETE. Replaying all seven stored reports will leave them
   incomplete unless one contains an explicit applicable negative; history will
   not be rewritten.

   instrument-owned live-shape arrays to compete with the 64 MiB growth threshold.
   Releasing obsolete networks will make a stateless multi-MLP positive control
   pass, while a deliberately retaining candidate will still fail. FLOPs may vary
   across different weight values and will be recorded rather than required equal.
3. **Lab/report entry point.** The captured dict/undefined-name writer failures and
   the malformed generated arm will reproduce before repair. Afterwards every
   registered arm will parse, invalid arms/control/output will refuse before truth
   reservation, and a tiny synthetic run through the real entry point will create
   one non-overwriting complete JSON report.
4. **Noise/statistics.** End-to-end reporting with unequal per-network multipliers
   will differ from universal-cancellation language by the predicted
   `(q_control-q_candidate)*v` term. A two-replica mean will report half the
   per-replica floor. Ordinary-alpha results will stay bit-identical; extreme
   unsupported alpha will either invert accurately or refuse explicitly rather
   than silently cap.
5. **Protected access.** The audit will identify `p2_corrector.py` as a bypass.
   Routing it through pre-read reservation will record an attempted/crashed read
   before loading and preserve P08's exhausted refusal and P01's three exposed
   DESIGN reads. Automatic receipts will distinguish measured execution time from
   historical supplied timestamps.
6. **Vault safety.** The Phase-1 live path will continue to refuse before opening
   arrays. Sacrificial fixtures will show one atomic reservation under concurrency,
   and a crash after reservation will consume the permitted look rather than make
   it silently reusable.
7. **Coherent K4.** An independently constructed dense polynomial/tensor oracle
   with signed nonconstant cores will reject the worker's scalar-derived
   projection and missing consumer/birth closure. A jointly derived core,
   transport, D4/D22/D31 consumers and K3 births will pass signed, repeated-index,
   cancellation, permutation, zero-core and zero-variance cases. The emitted
   exact/coherent/consumers-only/births-only switches will be independent;
   zero-core arms will nest into the exact control in both outputs and counted
   cost where the registered control requires parity.
8. **Compact all-history program.** A weighted-Gram/thin-QR implementation with
   factor rotations and carried Gram state will agree with a tiny dense
   all-history reference before compression. Its complete ledger will materially
   differ from the withdrawn `(r+n)` eigendecomposition estimate because it adds

## 2026-09-10 — SUPERSEDING CONTRACT: Stage-2 experiment 1, repaired coherent K4

**State: PREPARED, NOT ARMED. No protected labels may be opened until Samuel's new
predictions below are recorded and this entry is committed again.** This contract
supersedes `08f787b` for all future evidence. It does not erase that contract or its
three P01 DESIGN reads.

### Provenance correction

P01 is already exposed DESIGN data. The placeholder smoke used three P01 networks
and influenced the old proposed range. The promised “freeze before P01 is read”
chronology therefore cannot be met, and independent worker records did not recover
a defensible earlier chronology. P01 is never relabeled untouched. P07 remains
DESIGN; P08 remains spent and exhausted. The old Samuel predictions described the
rejected placeholder intervention and are not reused as predictions for the
repaired closure.

### Question and evidence

**Question.** After a bounded P07-only calibration, does the now-conformant coherent
K4 closure improve paired Phase-2 arithmetic score over the exact K3 control, and
does the improvement require both its consumers and induced births?

- **CONFIRMED:** the four switches parse and the exact/master-off control nests in
  output and counted cost on label-free fixtures.
- **CONFIRMED:** the compact represented program meters 0.372208 B at ranks 384/16;
  this is implementation cost, not accuracy evidence.
- **CONFIRMED:** P01 has three prior DESIGN reads; P07 is reusable DESIGN; P08 is
  exhausted. No untouched decision evidence exists for this intervention.
- **INFERRED:** the old theta=1 placeholder instability says only that its scale was
  unsuitable; it does not predict the repaired closure's sign or useful scale.
- **SPECULATIVE:** coherent consumers and births recover a depth-amplified relational
  fourth-order signal that neither half-arm captures alone.

### Hypothesis and mechanism

The per-neuron matrix-core K4 state changes both the current layer's D4/D22/D31
consumers and the K3 sources born for later layers. If the same represented
fourth-order signal matters through depth, the jointly coherent arm should beat the
exact control and both half-arms. A half-arm matching the whole falsifies the claim
that this coupling is the mechanism.

### Intervention and immutable fitting receipt

First implement a bounded fitting interface and prove it only on synthetic data.
Then fit only the explicitly registered structural coefficient(s) on P07, through
reserved reads, and write a non-overwriting receipt containing source hashes,
candidate grid or bounds, objective, identities, truth manifest, counted costs and
the frozen selected values. No autonomous sweep, public fit or P01-informed range
change is allowed. After freezing, run the four arms `exact`, `coherent`,
`consumers_only`, `births_only` on exposed P01 DESIGN data through `p2_lab.py`.

### Builder predictions

The Builder predicts only direction before labels: coherent should beat exact; both
half-arms should fall short of coherent; births-only is the likelier harmful half.
Magnitude is deliberately left to the isolated gate and Samuel's recorded range.
The complete compact program's 0.372208 B cost leaves counted-budget room, but its
server residual headroom is unknown.

### Samuel's predictions — REQUIRED BEFORE ARMING

1. Expected coherent-versus-exact arithmetic gain on this exposed DESIGN check:
   **PENDING SAMUEL**.
2. Expected mechanism result — coherent beats both half-arms, one half matches it,
   or no useful arm improves: **PENDING SAMUEL**.
3. Expected residual headroom against the 0.4 s server cliff for the compact
   rank-384/rank-16 reference: **PENDING SAMUEL**.

### Gate and falsifier

The isolated build gate remains a paired arithmetic score difference
`exact - coherent > 0` with the studentised-t 95% interval excluding zero and an
arithmetic gain of at least `1.10x`, passed to
`competition_score.decide(gate=1.10, interval="t")`. A DESIGN pass licenses a
fresh-DECIDE contract; it is not promotion. The mechanism claim also requires
coherent to exceed the better half-arm by at least `0.02x` descriptively. A gain
below `1.05x`, or either half-arm matching coherent within `0.02x`, falsifies the
stated mechanism on these DESIGN assets. Failure to pass the build gate is not a
general K4 kill.

### Baseline, cost, statistic and scope

The exact K3 arm is the control; all arms use common networks, one process and
identity alignment. Phase 2 has `lambda=0`, so cost is counted FLOPs only. Freeze
each arm's counted cost before scores. Report worst observed subprocess residual as
headroom `0.4 / observed`; local wall time is never quoted as authority. Report
each MSE with its truth floor, and report observed, noise-corrected and
official-precision arithmetic comparisons with unequal multipliers handled per
row. Studentised-t is binding; geometric ratios are diagnostic only.

No decision block, public truth, vault, estimator, frozen archive, L2 candidate,
submission, designation or eligibility action is authorized. After this DESIGN
result, stop for synthesis and a fresh Skeptic before writing any fresh-DECIDE
contract. Residual-rank, shared-basis and nested-tier questions remain later
separate interventions in GAME_PLAN order.

Commit `17eda81` implements `local_sim/p2_k4_fit.py` without opening labels. It
accepts only an explicit candidate registry and matching min/max bounds, exposes

The non-overwriting receipt uses exclusive creation and records identities,

## 2026-09-11 — CONTRACT AMENDMENT: compact four-arm Stage-2 implementation

**State: ARMED FOR LABEL-FREE IMPLEMENTATION ONLY.** This amendment replaces the
old full-history arm bytes and the phrase "exact K3 arm" where it named the
four-arm implementation control. It preserves the registered coefficient grid,
P07/P01 roles, fitting objective, scientific thresholds and all exposure records.
No P07 or P01 truth may be opened until the label-free gates and a fresh Skeptic
accept the actual compact generated bytes.

### Question and evidence

**Question.** Can the independently accepted compact all-history representation be
made into four grader-compatible arms whose K4 consumers and induced K3 births are
the only arm differences, with complete counted cost and memory evidence, so the
already registered P07 fit and P01 mechanism comparison test the intended method?

- **CONFIRMED:** the compact reference at recent 4, shared rank 384 and residual
  rank 16 meters 818,494,496,296 FLOPs (`0.372208 B`), 10,052 operations and about
  1,014 MiB observed process RAM at 1024x16. Its tiny dense closure and state-shadow
  tests and its weighted-Gram/thin-QR update received independent acceptance.
- **CONFIRMED:** the old generated coherent source is a different uncompressed
  all-history implementation. Jobs 824 and 877 show that its exact coefficient-zero
  bytes hit counted-budget exhaustion; RAM was not the cause. It never produced a
  fit package and supplies no accuracy result.
- **CONFIRMED:** the intended K4 core, its D4/D22/D31 consumers and induced K3 births
  pass the independent tiny dense oracle in the Stage-1 scope.
- **CONFIRMED:** P07 is reusable exposed DESIGN, P01 is exposed DESIGN with three
  recorded prior reads, and P08 is spent. The four-value `lam` registry and bounds
  remain frozen. Public and vault truth are outside scope.
- **INFERRED:** porting the accepted compact schedule into the generated candidates
  can retain its large counted-cost margin and roughly 1 GiB memory profile.
- **SPECULATIVE:** the coherent K4 signal improves the compact K3 control through
  the coupling of current consumers and future K3 births.

### Hypothesis, mechanism and intervention

The matrix-core K4 representation transports one residual core. Its D4, D22 and
D31 slices affect the current nonlinear closure, and its induced structured K3
birth affects later layers. If this is the useful depth mechanism, enabling both on
the same compact backbone should beat enabling either half alone.

Implement one grader-legal compact kernel using immutable float64 input weights,
float32 counted arithmetic, exact recent sources, every older source retained in a
rank-384 shared basis, a rank-16 explicit residual, weighted-Gram sketch, thin QR,
factor rotation, carried-Gram update, shared contractions, and the initial/final
shortcuts already proved in the reference. Emit `exact`, `coherent`,
`consumers_only` and `births_only` from that one kernel. In this comparison,
`exact` means the compact K4-off control: it shares every K3 compression and
schedule choice with the other arms. It does not claim that rank-384/rank-16
compression is an exact representation of all dense old sources.

Use the Stage-1B **total matrix-core** semantics: carry and project `gcore`
directly, without importing Stage-1A's separate scalar `c4` subtraction. Those
two accepted references are not mechanically compositional, and mixing them
would be a new unproved representation. Preserve the grader-facing orientation
(`W = raw_weight.T` in the reference formulas), the float64 exact first-layer
closed form, the finite/nonnegative output guards and shape-generic rank clamps.
These deployment operations were outside the old 818.494-billion reference
ledger and therefore must be included in the new executed per-arm ledgers.

`_K4_CONSUMERS` controls every D4/D22/D31 read and no birth; `_K4_BIRTHS` controls
every induced K3 feed/birth and no consumer; `_K4_ACTIVE` is their disjunction;
`_K4_LAM` is the sole registered fitted value. No arm may change source retention,
rank, residual, Wick closure, stabilization, dtype, layer schedule or cost guard.

### Predictions

Samuel's three predictions remain verbatim **"I don't know"**: gain, mechanism-arm
ordering and server residual headroom. The Builder predicts coherent will beat the
compact exact control, both half-arms will fall short, and births-only is the more
likely harmful half. These directions do not change the frozen gates or grid.

### Label-free implementation gate and falsifier

Before labels, require all of the following:

1. The compact kernel reproduces the independent tiny dense K4 closure, every
   consumer, every induced K3 birth, the old-source dense state shadow and
   full-rank compact/dense contractions within the existing Stage-1 tolerances.
2. Generated arms parse and import in the official environment. The compact exact
   arm is output- and counted-cost-identical to the same kernel with master K4 off.
   At `lam=1/3`, coherent matches the accepted compact reference's internal layer
   states before the newly required output-boundary operations; the new complete
   ledger, rather than the historical 818.494-billion number, is authoritative.
   Each half-arm changes only its literal registered switch, and zero-core nesting
   plus independent switch perturbations prove that consumers and births are
   neither aliased nor silently active in the control.
3. Run one label-free 1024x16 lifecycle/cost row per arm as separate workerq jobs
   with 4 GiB RAM, 2 CPUs and no GPU. Each must complete without lifecycle flags,
   stay below `2**41`, report all operation families and source hashes, remain below
   the 4 GiB declaration, and contain no array above 4 GiB. The coherent
   `lam=1/3` ledger must equal the executed compact reference algorithm; any
   difference must be explained and independently accepted before labels.
4. The production producer and standalone verifier must bind the new generator,
   compact kernel, registries, emitted sources, lifecycle settings, archives and
   receipts at stable-file boundaries. Positive, negative and incomplete-evidence
   fixtures and current preflight must pass on the final bytes.

Any dense-oracle mismatch, cross-arm change outside the four constants, missing
term or residual, budget/lifecycle failure, unexplained ledger mismatch, source
race, truth access or fresh Skeptic rejection falsifies readiness and keeps P07
closed. A failed implementation gate does not reject the K4 hypothesis.

After label-free acceptance, run the unchanged four-value `lam` grid on exact P07
identities without labels, verify its immutable producer package, then make the
next registered protected P07 access through `truth_reads` and freeze the selected
coefficient receipt. Run the four compact arms with that coefficient on exposed

`compact_exact - compact_coherent > 0`, studentised-t 95% interval excluding zero,
and at least `1.10x` arithmetic gain through
`competition_score.decide(gate=1.10, interval="t")`. The mechanism claim still
requires coherent to beat the better half-arm by at least `0.02x` descriptively;
gain below `1.05x` or a half-arm within `0.02x` falsifies that mechanism on these
DESIGN assets. Report every MSE with its truth noise floor.

Phase 2 has competition lambda zero, so `C=F`; each arm's measured counted FLOPs
and official server offset determine its multiplier. Residual time is only
headroom `0.4 / worst observed subprocess residual`, never a local timing claim.
Memory evidence is accounting on Windows plus measured workerq peak, not proof of

positive DESIGN synthesis may license a separately committed fresh-DECIDE contract

No edit to `estimator.py`, frozen archives, `docs/HUMAN_MODEL.md`, the standing L2

### Locked-snapshot selector repair after Skeptic rejection

The producer no longer imports the selector at module load. Its production path

### IMPORTANT bridge contract — freeze P07 selection into the P01 arms

**Question.** Can the next P01 mechanism report mechanically prove that all four
arms were generated from the immutable coefficient selected by the registered P07
fit, while keeping the competition cost lambda distinct and holding every source
stable through report publication?

**Evidence.** CONFIRMED: the fitter writes `selection.frozen_values.lam`, but the
generator accepts an arbitrary CLI `--lam` and overwrites shared default arms.
CONFIRMED: current `p2_lab.py` accepts no fit/freeze receipt; its `--lam` is the
competition cost coefficient, not `_K4_LAM`; it checks only that arm files exist
and parse before truth. CONFIRMED: lifecycle rows contain candidate hashes, but the
lab does not bind a common selected coefficient or hold all arm/receipt/generator
bytes through its scored and depth passes. INFERRED: without a receipt-driven
bridge, a stale default arm or a value passed to the wrong `--lam` can create a
plausible but invalid P01 report. No labels were read for this audit.

**Prediction.** A nondefault synthetic P07 selection will generate four fresh
immutable arm files that all encode exactly the selected K4 coefficient and differ
only by registered mechanism switches. The P01 runner will refuse stale, mixed,
mutated or misbound arms and receipts before truth access, will record K4 lambda
separately from Phase-2 competition lambda zero, and will remove/refuse any report
whose dependencies change before closing publication. Existing score/noise/gate
semantics will remain unchanged.

**Intervention.** Add a receipt-driven freezer that strictly validates the fit
receipt's protected-design P07 role, objective, selected index/value, candidate
registry/bounds/identity bindings, truth-read reservation evidence and current
nontruth source hashes. From a locked generator/template snapshot, render the four
registered arms into a fresh experiment directory and publish an immutable freeze
receipt last. Extend `p2_lab.py` to require and validate that receipt before truth,
hold fit/freeze receipts, generator/template, arms and relevant instrument sources
through all lifecycle/depth evaluations and exclusive report publication, compare
executed lifecycle hashes to frozen hashes, closing-rehash everything, and record
both receipt hashes plus `k4_lam` and `competition_cost_lambda`. Keep the accepted
default arms and every job-894 dependency untouched.

**Fixtures and falsifier.** Positive synthetic nondefault fit-to-freeze-to-lab;
missing/malformed/wrong-role/mutated receipt; stale/default/mixed/wrong-lambda arm;
mutation between validation, lifecycle, depth and publication; forged lifecycle
hash; and existing-output refusal, all before protected truth or without an
accepted report. Any ambiguous lambda field, unbound dependency, accepted mutation,
changed score/noise/gate behavior, current preflight failure or fresh Skeptic
rejection blocks P01. This is IMPORTANT instrument work, uses no seed block and
opens no research truth.

## 2026-09-12 — F21 preregistration: one exact D21 shared-right contraction

**Class:** STRATEGIC candidate and future DECIDE; the independent tiny math probe
is IMPORTANT. This entry precedes candidate measurements and any new seed read.
Samuel's response to the bundled three-prediction request on 2026-09-12 was
**"i dont know proceed"**. Recorded before any F21 result: (1) tiny exact
contraction **I don't know**; (2) at least 8% counted-cost saving with bounded
rounding **I don't know**; (3) fresh paired `1.05x` score gate **I don't know**.

**Question.** Can fusing two D21 products that share `M.T` lower the complete
counted cost of the best-public L4 own-code estimator without material accuracy,
shape, lifecycle, or deployment regression? Does its paired competition score
beat original L4 on fresh Phase-2 networks?

**Evidence.** CONFIRMED: frozen L2 SHA256
`390bc226bbf517df0110facfc0dc91c78ef670e8a49368a536cabf630057d1db`;
L4 `estimator.py` member in `submission-k3strassen-L4.tar.gz` SHA256
`052dd768e970c4bae831cff26f8ff15b0487f3b95eadf2fd3578e542aec34d58`.
CONFIRMED: L4 is the best-public current score, but its dated unpaired public
mean and wall reading do not prove a new candidate. INFERRED: 14 actual wide
products/105 lineage equivalents disappear at depth 16. SPECULATIVE: roughly
13% dominant-work saving and any total cost, runtime, or score improvement.

**Hypothesis and mechanism.** Distributivity changes
`2*mm(A_D*M,M.T)+3*mm(A_L*C,M.T)`, `C=A_L*w2b`, into
`mm(2*(A_D*M)+3*(A_L*C),M.T)`, removing one wide matmul per noninitial D21
read. Float32/Strassen rounding may alter the trajectory; the hypothesis is
that its score effect is smaller than the counted-cost reduction.

**Intervention and frozen selection.** Construct exactly one candidate from
the L4 member. Change only `_dslice21`'s named terms and its explanatory
comment. Keep the other products, `/3`, off-mask, D3, full Wick/centering,
source births, all history, scalar K4, saturation, dtype, backend, setup,
and conservative generation chooser byte-identical. No fused L2 candidate or
backend selection on DECIDE; original L2 is robustness context on the same
networks. No coefficient fitting, budget spending, rank change, or calibration.

**Predictions before results.** (1) Tiny exact rational dense tensor and both
oriented contraction controls, including signed cancellation, zero, non-square
lineage and off-diagonal mask, agree exactly. Actual float32 need not be bitwise.
(2) Fixed backend/precision trajectories will have normalized per-entry error
`abs(new-old)/max(1,abs(old)) <= 2e-3` at every sampled state/source field and
output, and final-output relative RMS error `<= 1e-2`; no nonfinite or shape
regression. (3) Full official-stack counted FLOPs fall at least 8% against the
same L4 parent, after all operand additions and materializations. On exposed
DESIGN, paired mean score will not regress more than 5%; on fresh DECIDE the
candidate will clear the isolated `1.05x` arithmetic gain gate against L4.
These are hypotheses, not measured values.

**Engineering gate/falsifier.** A source diff outside the named contraction,
failed tiny exact/orientation/mask check, any trajectory bound failure, new
failure/nonfinite state, fewer than 8% total counted-FLOP savings, or a
resource/lifecycle failure rejects this implementation for promotion. Complete
metering uses the official flopscope/WhestBench stack on live 1024x16 shape,
with immutable flopscope arrays, actual float32 and unchanged Strassen backend.
Record operation families, new left-operand construction, materialization,
setup separately, and peak process RAM where measured. The 8% threshold is on
the **isolated candidate-minus-original-L4** counted program, not on a mixed
baseline. A cost screen failure is not a scientific kill of exact fusion.

required path or age/rank loss falsifies this scoped prediction. Do not
